ranked.headline: Transcriptomic and machine-learning pipelines nominate candidate disease biomarkers
ranked.summary: Public omics resources and single-cell data now routinely yield ML-prioritized candidate genes that still require experimental confirmation.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic profiling links tumor microenvironment states to prognostic risk models
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial layers are increasingly combined with bulk cohort signatures to derive prognostic and mechanistic hypotheses across tumor types.

ranked.headline: Models couple histology, spatial neighborhoods and molecular profiles in tissue
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair H&E images with spatial transcriptomics and proteomics to predict or enhance molecular profiles at single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial profiling links T and B cell states to immunotherapy response
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial readouts now pair immune cell states with TCR and BCR repertoires to relate those states to therapeutic outcome.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised and linear models predict transcriptional responses to perturbations
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of single-cell foundation models against simple baselines test whether learned representations add predictive value.
